description: Add authentic monochromatic film grain to your photos with an adjustable intensity slider — the analog look, instantly.

faqs.a: Real film grain is random silver-halide clumps, not uniform noise. This tool adds per-pixel random luminance grain, which reads as authentic grain at normal intensities.
Drag the slider toward 100 for a gritty 35mm-pushed look, or keep it under 25 for a subtle texture.
faqs.q: How strong should the grain be?

faqs.a: Yes — everything is computed on your photo's pixels in your browser.

howto: Drag the intensity slider to taste — the preview updates live.
Try 10–25 for subtle texture, 50+ for a gritty film look.
Click "Download image" to save the PNG.
title: Film Grain Effect
